title: gatewatch: merged audit trigger change without explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit 8e3e573083ea41e4e4329b2dbed33aa4a59a5a21; file .warren/triggers.yaml (new, lines 1-47), including gatewatch-patrol and other audit trigger entries. Article IX requires changes to .warren/triggers.yaml audit entries to receive explicit human review and not ride an auto-merged PR. The merged commit is an ordinary Warren configuration commit with no explicit human sign-off recorded in the commit metadata or diff; it therefore requires review as a mandate-protection finding.
